async function ironSmeltRawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {

If not, it calculates how many raw iron pieces are needed to reach the target. It then verifies that enough raw iron and a suitable fuel source are available in the inventory. Finally, it ensures a furnace is present and then smelts the necessary raw iron into iron ingots.
